q: In a saddle-node bifurcation (fold bifurcation), as the parameter crosses the bifurcation value:
opts: A stable and unstable equilibrium collide and disappear
A stable equilibrium splits into two
The Jacobian eigenvalues cross the imaginary axis as complex pair
exp: Saddle-node: a stable and an unstable equilibrium approach each other as μ → μ_c, coalesce at μ = μ_c, and vanish for μ > μ_c (or vice versa). No equilibria exist on one side.
